name: obs-video-trigger
description: Plays a video once, fullscreen and unmuted, in an OBS browser source. Triggered from a Stream Deck.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console --windows-title="OBS Video Trigger" --windows-description="Plays a clip once in an OBS browser source" --windows-version=1.0.0.0 --outfile dist/obs-video-trigger.exe src/main.ts
